verses.pali: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.
verses.english: Then King Pasenadi of Kosala went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side.

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro puriso yena rājā pasenadi kosalo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa upakaṇṇake ārocesi:
verses.english: Then a man went up to the king and whispered in his ear,
“Your Majesty, Queen Mallikā has given birth to a daughter.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, rājā pasenadi kosalo anattamano ahosi.
verses.english: When this was said, King Pasenadi was disappointed.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā rājānaṁ pasenadiṁ kosalaṁ anattamanataṁ viditvā tāyaṁ velāyaṁ imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
verses.english: Then, knowing that King Pasenadi was disappointed, on that occasion the Buddha recited these verses:
“Well, some women are better than men,
Wise and virtuous, a devoted wife
And when she has a son,
he becomes a hero, O lord of the land.
The son of such a blessed lady
